INTJ.name: The Architect
INTJ.subtitle: Strategic and independent mindset
INTJ.description: A strategist with a plan for everything and rich imagination.
INTJ.detailedDescription: INTJs value logic and strategy even in romance. They want a partner who can grow intellectually together, and though they may be awkward at expressing emotions, they are very devoted to those they trust.
INTJ.idealDate: A night of debate or visiting a science museum.

INTP.name: The Logician
INTP.subtitle: Innovative inventor
INTP.description: An innovative inventor with an endless thirst for knowledge.
INTP.detailedDescription: INTPs are free thinkers. They value intellectual stimulation even in romance and prefer comfortable relationships that respect each other's privacy and preferences.
INTP.idealDate: Bookstore trip followed by deep conversation in a cafe.

ENTJ.name: The Commander
ENTJ.subtitle: Bold and imaginative leader
ENTJ.description: A strong-willed leader who always finds a way.
ENTJ.detailedDescription: ENTJs bring a lot of energy and vision to relationships. They pursue a 'power couple' dynamic relationship and are reliable partners who actively help their partner grow.
ENTJ.idealDate: Dinner at a fine restaurant or playing strategic board games.

ENTP.name: The Debater
ENTP.subtitle: Inventor who enjoys intellectual challenges
ENTP.description: An original thinker who can't resist interesting intellectual challenges.
ENTP.detailedDescription: ENTPs are brainstormers who constantly come up with new ideas. You need a partner who can enjoy your playful debates, and you aim for a fun romance with never a dull moment.
ENTP.idealDate: Watching a comedy show or learning a new hobby together.

INFJ.name: The Advocate
INFJ.subtitle: Calm and mysterious idealist
INFJ.description: A quiet but insightful idealist who inspires people.
INFJ.detailedDescription: INFJs are rare people with deep inner worlds. They have high ideals about relationships and seek a soulmate who deeply understands each other and exchanges inspiration.
INFJ.idealDate: Stargazing or a walk in quiet and beautiful nature.

INFP.name: The Mediator
INFP.subtitle: Passionate and kind altruist
INFP.description: Passionate people who always dedicate themselves to good causes.
INFP.detailedDescription: INFPs follow their hearts. They value authenticity and emotional depth above all else, and become the most faithful supporters who cheer for their partner's dreams and growth.
INFP.idealDate: A cozy picnic or visiting an old used bookstore.

ENFJ.name: The Protagonist
ENFJ.subtitle: Charismatic and inspiring leader
ENFJ.description: A passionate leader who encourages people and wants to create a better world.
ENFJ.detailedDescription: ENFJs are natural helpers. They are very sensitive to their partner's feelings and needs, and excel at creating a warm and encouraging relationship atmosphere.
ENFJ.idealDate: Doing volunteer work together or hosting a small gathering with close friends.

ENFP.name: The Campaigner
ENFP.description: A passionate and creative free spirit who always finds joy.
ENFP.subtitle: Free-spirited soul
ENFP.detailedDescription: ENFPs infuse curiosity and energy into relationships. They value emotional bonds and always try to make the relationship more interesting in new ways.
ENFP.idealDate: Attending a lively festival or spontaneous trip without plans.

ISTJ.name: The Logistician
ISTJ.subtitle: Practical and devoted administrator
ISTJ.description: Responsible people who think based on facts and are reliable.
ISTJ.detailedDescription: ISTJs are the cornerstone of stability. Though not highly expressive, they show love through actions. They demonstrate commitment through trust, practical help, and building a stable future together.
ISTJ.idealDate: Dinner at a traditional and verified restaurant and organized activities like bowling.

ISFJ.name: The Defender
ISFJ.subtitle: Devoted and warm protector
ISFJ.description: Dedicated people who do their best to protect those close to them.
ISFJ.detailedDescription: ISFJs are very thoughtful. They remember small things their partner likes, and are devoted lovers who prioritize their partner's comfort and happiness over their own needs.
ISFJ.idealDate: Cooking special meals together at home or quiet movie watching.

ESTJ.name: The Executive
ESTJ.subtitle: Excellent organizational operator
ESTJ.description: A practitioner with excellent ability to manage things and people.
ESTJ.detailedDescription: ESTJs bring structure and trust. They openly state what they want and express love by organizing a stable life and being a reliable teammate.
ESTJ.idealDate: Dining at a well-known authentic restaurant or watching a sports game.

ESFJ.name: The Consul
ESFJ.subtitle: Compassionate and sociable personality
ESFJ.description: A popular personality who finds happiness in helping those around them.
ESFJ.detailedDescription: ESFJs are the life of the party and the center of the home. They are sensitive to their partner's happiness and social relationships, and want to express and confirm love through frequent communication and gatherings.
ESFJ.idealDate: Double date with friends or attending a lively local festival.

ISTP.name: The Virtuoso
ISTP.subtitle: Bold and practical analyzer
ISTP.description: A practitioner skilled at handling various tools and solving problems.
ISTP.detailedDescription: ISTPs are people who enjoy the present. They need a lot of personal space and prefer to build intimacy through adventure and activities together rather than emotional conversations.
ISTP.idealDate: Hiking, climbing, or hands-on date making something together.

ISFP.name: The Adventurer
ISFP.subtitle: Flexible and charming artist
ISFP.description: An artist who always seeks new experiences and enjoys the present.
ISFP.detailedDescription: ISFPs are people with unique individuality. They are very sensitive to their partner's needs and surrounding atmosphere, and want a partner who can understand their quiet creative world.
ISFP.idealDate: Visiting an art gallery or outdoor date where you can see beautiful sunsets.

ESTP.name: The Entrepreneur
ESTP.subtitle: Smart and energetic wheeler-dealer
ESTP.description: An activist who doesn't fear risk and seizes opportunities of the moment.
ESTP.detailedDescription: ESTPs are action-oriented. Charismatic and persuasive, they live for thrilling moments. They prefer bright energy to overly deep analysis, enjoying fun together through activities.
ESTP.idealDate: Energetic concert or thrilling sports game watching.

ESFP.name: The Entertainer
ESFP.description: A performer who makes others happy and energizes them.
ESFP.subtitle: Sociable and active personality
ESFP.detailedDescription: ESFPs bring vitality wherever they go. They carefully take care of their partner to always keep them happy and enjoy glamorous and lively romance sharing present emotions and sensory experiences.
ESFP.idealDate: Going dancing together or attending a glamorous event.
